description: Preferred way to build a slide for a deck that will be PRESENTED. Composes ONE self-contained, full-bleed HTML graphic — baking in the sizing/theme rules that make slides render correctly in Present mode — and places it on the slide. By default it also sets the slide layout to `viz-full` and clears the slide title (render the title inside the graphic via `title`/`eyebrow`). Write your visual/columns as `bodyHtml`; you may reference theme CSS vars var(--ink), var(--body), var(--muted), var(--panel), var(--border), var(--accent) inside it so content matches the theme. Use LARGE fonts (title ~48-52px, body ~22-24px) — the block is scaled down to fit the frame. Do NOT set aspect-ratio in bodyHtml; the wrapper handles sizing via min-height.

accent.description: Accent color (any CSS color). Overrides the theme default; also exposed as var(--accent).

align.description: Vertical alignment of content in the frame. Default center.

bodyHtml.description: Inner HTML for the slide body (columns, cards, charts, bars). May use theme CSS vars: var(--ink), var(--body), var(--muted), var(--panel), var(--border), var(--accent). Rendered below the optional eyebrow/title.

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase kicker above the title, accent-colored (plain text; HTML-escaped).

minHeight.description: Root min-height in px so the background fills the slide card. Default 960; lower only for deliberately sparse slides.

setLayout.description: Also set the slide to viz-full and clear its title. Default true — turn off if you are managing layout/title yourself.

title.description: Slide headline, rendered large inside the graphic (plain text; HTML-escaped).

name: add_slide_graphic
